'''Kollan Xa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who represented the [[Ccalras Corporation]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He wore bright [[Color/Legends|red]] clothes.

His bodyguard was the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Kov Du Derra]].

During that time, as part of his work with Ccalras, he and Kov kidnapped [[Beeyon Nace]]'s lover [[Eila]] to help with negotiating. He also had a room at the [[Lucky Despot]].

A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] aiding Nace trailed Du Derra and rescued Eila. However, they later see that she joined with Xa, Du Derra, and [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian thugs]] to con Nace into reporting on Mos Eisley customs patrols.

==Behind the scenes==
Kollan Xa appears in in [[West End Games]]' [[1997]] ''[[Mos Eisley Adventure Set]]''.

As part of the adventure's conclusion, the book suggests that the characters succeed in driving off Xa and the thugs.
